address: 12565 Washington Blvd., Los Angeles, CA, 90066, USA
bio: Who doesn't love a good comeback story? Chef/owner Ray Garcia's Broken Spanish Comedor is a reincarnation of his former restaurant, resurrecting signature favorites alongside a menu of nostalgic-yet-elevated Mexican cooking with bold flavors. The menu isn't huge, but it has plenty of hits, as evidenced by the crowds that flock here (definitely make reservations). Start the meal with botanas like kanpachi ceviche or their aguachile negro with bay scallops before moving into starters like the roasted mushroom, spinach and honeynut squash tamal en cazuela. Don't even think about skipping their signature dish — crispy pork belly chicharron in a garlic mojo sauce is a must.
